title: Operto Review, Pricing & Alternatives (2026)
summary: Operto review for 2026: smart locks and mobile keys as the core product, guest and staff modules around them, and how it compares to a guest AI agent.
body_markdown:
*Written by Punn Kam, ex-Google AI engineer and Y Combinator repeat founder. He is the co-founder of Conduit, an AI agent platform built for hospitality, serving 300+ hospitality brands in 140+ languages. Last updated September 15, 2026.*


Operto manages smart locks, mobile keys, and contactless check-in, alongside guest experience and staff operations. It says it serves 20,000+ property managers and hoteliers in 90+ countries and integrates with 150+ third-party systems. Its homepage does not list prices. Guest messaging is part of its Operto Guest module.


## What is Operto?


Operto sells four modules. Operto Access covers access control, mobile keys, contactless check-in, and lock upgrades. Operto Guest covers digital guidebooks, guest messaging, contracts, and upselling. Operto Teams covers staff scheduling, maintenance tracking, and task management. Operto ONE is described as AI-powered intelligence for hotels.


Physical access is central to Operto. Its guest messaging features sit in the Operto Guest module. If you are looking for an agent to resolve guest requests, check what that module can do alongside the access tools.


## How much does Operto cost?


Operto does not publish pricing on its homepage; it routes to a separate pricing page. Treat any specific figure you find elsewhere as an estimate until you see it from Operto directly.


For comparison, Visito publishes from $99/month, Jurny publishes $19 per unit with a $400 monthly minimum, and Conduit publishes $18 per unit per month for Messaging up to $48 for Full Suite. Akia, HelloShift, Asksuite, Bookboost, and Hostaway do not publish list prices.


## What is Operto good at?


- **Access.** Mobile keys, access control, and contactless check-in are core parts of the product.
- **Breadth of integrations.** 150+ third-party systems including major PMS platforms and lock providers.
- **Property types.** Operto serves hotels, vacation rentals, student housing, multi-family, and mixed-use properties.
- **Teams.** Staff scheduling and maintenance sit in the same platform as access, which lets teams manage lock problems and the work to fix them together.


## Where does Operto fall short?


- **Guest request handling.** If guest questions go unanswered, ask which requests Operto Guest can resolve automatically and which need staff.
- **Phone coverage.** No AI voice product is described. Confirm how you would cover guest calls.
- **Pricing.** Check the dedicated pricing page; the homepage does not list rates.
- **Operto ONE needs a closer look.** Its public description is high level. Ask for a demonstration using your own data.


## Should you replace Operto or add to it?


If Operto handles your locks and mobile keys reliably, first compare tools that can work with it. Replacing your access system adds work when the immediate problem is unanswered guest messages.


Test the connection between messaging and access in a demo. When a guest says "my code doesn't work," can the agent resolve the problem or reissue the code, and when does staff need to step in?

## FAQ


### Is Operto a guest messaging platform?


Operto focuses on access and operations, with guest messaging included in its Operto Guest module. Check that module's automation capabilities against the requests your team handles.


### Does Operto publish pricing?


Not on its homepage. It routes to a separate pricing page, so verify figures there rather than trusting third-party estimates.


### What is Operto ONE?


Operto describes it as AI-powered intelligence for hotels. The public description is high level, so ask for a demonstration using your own data.


### Can Operto replace my guest communication tool?


Compare Operto Guest's messaging features with what your team uses today. If you keep a separate guest agent, test whether it can act on Operto's access system when a code fails.


### What is the best Operto alternative for access plus messaging in one tool?


Conduit's Guest + Devices tier at $36 per unit per month combines device workflows with the guest agent. Compare its device support with Operto's dedicated access features, then test the guest requests you need each to handle.
